pairs.subject: i18n
pairs.evidence: src/i18n/useTranslation.ts:20 For reachable non-English locales, activation starts after mount against an English hydration snapshot, allowing an English flash before the selected catalog loads.

techniques.evidence: src/i18n/en.ts:2017 The source catalog conforms to a separately maintained interface; the required source-derived type generation and section regeneration are absent from the inspected build scripts.

src/i18n/de.ts:375 This rendered FAQ question remains identical to English while coverage reports 100% and the ledger passes; identical values are tolerated through a nonzero ratchet rather than blocked.

scripts/check-i18n-encoding.mjs:168 The checker implements per-file ceilings, tightening reminders, nonempty-input assertions, and a hard-zero shipping lane; its read-only run passed, subject to the escaped-content blind spot described below.
src/stores/i18nStore.ts:117 The shared per-locale release predicate filters switcher options, rejects withheld setter requests, and normalizes withheld or unknown persisted values to English.

src/components/sections/feature-voting/components/FeatureVotingSummary.tsx:58 Plural selection uses a fixed singular-versus-other comparison, so the shared catalog cannot express locale-specific categories such as Czech few or Arabic two and many.
src/i18n/useTranslation.ts:17 The server snapshot is explicitly English and locale activation occurs in useEffect; persisted-locale sections do not finish a bounded preload before the initial render.

src/styles/typography.css:97 Arabic headings receive negative tracking despite the connected-script rule requiring natural spacing; typography overrides also enumerate languages instead of resolving a script.
scripts/i18n/check.mjs:17 The extraction detector is explicitly advisory and omitted from the aggregate gate, so new hardcoded display strings are not blocked.
src/components/LanguageSwitcher.tsx:47 Locale IDs remain the selection and persistence tokens while the adjacent rendering uses endonym labels; changing a label does not change locale identity.
